articles.summary: Most lifters quit running in two weeks. Here's how to add running to your lifting routine without losing muscle or wrecking your recovery.
articles.title: How to Start Running as a Lifter Without Losing Muscle

articles.summary: A hybrid athlete is anyone training to improve in both strength and cardio at the same time. The goal is overall performance, not a single max.
articles.title: What Does It Mean to Be a Hybrid Athlete?
